sealed_record.thesis: The optical component sector has underperformed absurdly versus demand visibility: AOI, Elazr and Sivers management all cite shortages persisting 3-5 years across the whole optical supply chain, and the industry is already bottlenecked at EML/CW, PDs/TIA/DSPs, transceivers and soon FAU before CPO even scales. Lumentum (LITE) is a direct EML/laser/transceiver supplier levered to the exact 1.6T, NPO and CPO scale-out inflection that hasn't been hit yet, and sits upstream of the AAOI trade already on the blocklist. The market keeps mispricing near-term optics weakness while confirmed multi-year demand imbalances remain unaddressed.
